turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Nimbus Broadband support. Am I speaking with the account holder?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks Rohan. For verification, could you tell me the last four digits of your registered mobile number?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, you're verified. How can I help today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The internet's been really slow since morning. Video calls keep freezing.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sorry about that. I've checked and there's no reported outage in your area. Could you look at your router and tell me which lights are on?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Power is green, internet is green, and the Wi-Fi one is blinking.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That looks normal. Is it slow on every device, or just one?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: All of them. Laptop and phone both.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay. Let's restart the router. Please switch it off at the plug, wait thirty seconds, then switch it back on. I'll stay on the line.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, it's back. All lights green.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great. Could you run a speed test in the Nimbus app and read me the download speed?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Your plan is 100 Mbps, so that's where it should be. Could you try a quick video call?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Glad that fixed it. To sum up: no outage in your area, we restarted the router, and your speed is back to 96 Mbps. If it slows down again, call us back and we'll send a technician. Anything else?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, that's it. Thanks a lot.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're welcome, Rohan. Have a good day.
